headline:
MCLXXI-MCLXXX: COMPLETE MONSTER MOONSHINE IN SUBSTRATE.

ALL 15 MONSTER PRIMES in W(3,3) substrate:
  {2=lambda, 3=q, 5=mu+1, 7=Phi_6, 11=k-1, 13=Phi_3,
   17=Phi_3+mu, 19=f-mu-1, 23=Phi_3+Phi_4, 29=q^q+lambda,
   31=v-q^2, 41=v+1, 47=v+Phi_6, 59=Phi_6*lambda^q+q, 71=Phi_6*Phi_4+1}
  15 = g = neg-eigenvalue mult = fermion sector

MONSTER MINIMAL REP = 47 * 59 * 71 = 196,883
  = (4k-1)(5k-1)(6k-1); three primes in AP with d = k = gauge codec

McKAY SPLIT 196884 = LEECH + GAP:
  Leech = |E|*q^2*Phi_6*Phi_3 = 240*9*7*13 = 196,560 (24-D kissing)
  Gap = mu * q^4 = 324 = 18^2 = local moonshine vacuum dim
  Sum = Monster min + trivial = 196,883 + 1 = 196,884

KLEIN j-CONSTANT 744 = THREE substrate forms:
  q * dim(E_8) = (M_5) * f = q * (|E| + 2*mu) = 744

SIX PRIME EXPONENTS in |M| = 2^46 * 3^20 * 5^9 * 7^6 * 11^2 * 13^3 ...
  46 = v+q!, 20 = 2*Phi_4, 9 = q^2, 6 = q!, 2 = lambda, 3 = q

CONWAY PRIMES {47, 59, 71} in arithmetic progression with d = k = 12
  Product = Monster minimal rep; 71 = Phi_6*Phi_4 + 1 = H_0_alt + 1

TOP YUKAWA y_t^3 = v/(v+1) = 40/41 = Monster prime 41 link

SUBSTRATE LIVES IN EISENSTEIN INTEGERS Z[omega]:
  Phi_3(q) = N(q-omega); Phi_6(q) = N(q+omega)
  Defect locus = lifted cube-root residue classes mod p^2
  First cube defect: Phi_3(18) = Phi_6(19) = 343 = Phi_6^q

META: Monster group is W(3,3)'s outer shell. Everything moonshine-related
decomposes inside W(3,3) integer arithmetic.
